description: This file defines the ExampleStorageAttributeMapper class, which implements the IAttributeToFactoryMapper interface for mapping ExampleStorageAttribute to a factory function that creates storage instances based on provided parameters and context.

classes.name: ExampleStorageAttributeMapper
classes.description: Implements mapping from ExampleStorageAttribute to a factory function for storage creation, utilizing reflection and dependency injection.

methods.name: GetFactory
methods.description: Generates a factory function based on the provided parameter info and attribute, setting up the storage configuration and preparing the method for invocation.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Invokes the factory method to create a storage instance using the context and provided arguments.
